llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to help coordinate multi-agent coding work. Keep spawned agents confined to separate files or working directories, review generated prompts and sed commands before running them, and do not include secrets or sensitive internal API data in shared agent instructions.
llm.summary: This is a documentation-only skill for coordinating parallel coding agents, with the main risk being normal user-approved file changes by spawned agents.
